company.name: RSA Cross Border
company.shortDescription: RSA Cross-Border is a newly independent AI-powered technology startup that spun out from RSA Global.
company.description: RSA Cross Border is designed for companies that already move parcels across borders and want to scale faster, with less operational friction.The company provides infrastructure and software that help sellers, platforms, and consolidators create optimized international shipping networks by unbundling traditional logistics services into modular components, RSA Cross-Border enables faster, more flexible, and cost-efficient global shipping solutions.
